title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #10

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does Surah Al-Ikhlas teach us most? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth saves people
   B. We should fight our neighbours
   C. Allah is One and has no equal
   D. Prayer is not needed

2. What is tajweed? (1 mark)
   A. Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   B. A type of charity
   C. The call to prayer
   D. A kind of prayer mat

3. How many verses does Surah An-Naas have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 7

4. Which of these follows the Sunnah of eating? (1 mark)
   A. Eat while running
   B. Criticise the food
   C. Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   D. Use the left hand for pleasure

5. Which of these is bad eating manners? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting calmly
   B. Waiting for elders
   C. Talking with a full mouth
   D. Taking small bites

6. Which of these is a benefit of clean teeth? (1 mark)
   A. More cavities
   B. Fresh breath
   C. Bad breath
   D. Toothache

7. What is the correct way to mention an angel's name? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing
   B. Say "alayhis-salam"
   C. Say "S.A.W."
   D. Insult

8. What are angels created from? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Clay
   C. Water
   D. Light

9. Which angel will blow the Trumpet? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Jibril
   C. Israfil
   D. Atid

10. Who was Yusuf's father? (1 mark)
   A. Ismail
   B. Ishaq
   C. Ibrahim
   D. Yaqub

11. What is the meaning of generosity? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping everything
   B. Giving freely without expecting anything back
   C. Refusing to share
   D. Boasting

12. Which example is a light najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   B. Dog saliva
   C. Blood
   D. Urine of an adult

13. Which is a health reason for washing away najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. It makes food taste sweet
   B. It prevents diseases like diarrhoea
   C. It makes us taller
   D. It stops rain

14. Why is wudhu important? (1 mark)
   A. It replaces prayer
   B. It is a game
   C. It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   D. It makes prayer shorter

15. Which of these shows waste in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving the tap running
   B. Using a small jug
   C. Saving water
   D. Closing the tap

16. How far are the arms washed? (1 mark)
   A. Up to the shoulder
   B. Up to and including the elbows
   C. Only the wrist
   D. Only the palm

17. Which is the correct order in one rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting, standing, bowing
   B. Sujud, ruku, Fatiha
   C. Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   D. Ruku, Fatiha, sujud

18. What is the tashahhud? (1 mark)
   A. The niyyah
   B. The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   C. The call to prayer
   D. A bowing

19. What did the Prophet say about learning to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Pray in any way
   B. Never pray
   C. Pray quickly
   D. Pray as you have seen me praying

20. What does "Allahu Akbar" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Glory to Allah
   B. Allah is One
   C. All praise belongs to Allah
   D. Allah is the Greatest

21. Which of these is one of Allah's creatures? (1 mark)
   A. A goat
   B. A chair
   C. A phone
   D. A stone wall

22. What is a good media rule? (1 mark)
   A. Download any app
   B. Share passwords
   C. Ask parents before using devices
   D. Use a phone secretly

23. What should come before screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Games
   B. Prayer, homework and helping at home
   C. Videos
   D. Nothing

24. Which is a life skill related to this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Wasting money
   C. Avoiding begging without justification
   D. Gambling

25. What did the Prophet say about cutting and selling firewood? (1 mark)
   A. It is forbidden
   B. It is better than asking people
   C. It is only for the poor
   D. It is shameful

26. What does Qur'an 93:10 say about the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Do not drive him away
   B. Shout at him
   C. Laugh at him
   D. Ignore him

27. How should we give sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. With shame
   B. Loudly to embarrass
   C. Quietly and kindly
   D. With insults

28. What should we say to family after entering? (1 mark)
   A. Hello only
   B. Goodbye
   C. As-salamu alaykum
   D. Nothing

29. What can a child do when a parent is sick? (1 mark)
   A. Play loudly
   B. Leave
   C. Bring water, help and make dua
   D. Ignore

30. What does the Qur'an place right after worshipping Allah in Surah 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. Journey
   B. Being kind to parents
   C. Fasting
   D. Trade

31. When should we not obey parents? (1 mark)
   A. When they command something Allah forbids
   B. When they ask for water
   C. When they ask us to study
   D. When they call us

32. Which greeting is used with relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Silence
   B. Shouting
   C. Insults
   D. As-salamu alaykum

33. What should you do if a relative does not visit you? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore their events
   B. Insult them
   C. Never talk to them
   D. Still visit them kindly

34. Which angel brought the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Mikail
   C. Raqib
   D. Israfil

35. In which cave did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Thawr
   B. Hira
   C. Safa
   D. Uhud

36. About how old was the Prophet at the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. About sixty
   B. About twenty
   C. About ten
   D. About forty

37. What did Abu Bakr do with his wealth? (1 mark)
   A. Wasted it
   B. Refused to give
   C. Hid it
   D. Freed believers and supported Islam

38. What did some people of Taif do as he left? (1 mark)
   A. Cheered him
   B. Threw stones at him
   C. Gave him food
   D. Followed him

39. Who travelled with the Prophet to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Zayd ibn Haritha
   B. Ali
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Bilal

40. What is the period of Khadija's and Abu Talib's deaths called? (1 mark)
   A. The Year of Sorrow
   B. The Year of Elephant
   C. The Year of Joy
   D. The Year of Hijrah

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give three manners of making dua. (3 marks)

42. Describe how the Prophet (S.A.W.) solved the dispute over placing the Black Stone. (3 marks)

43. State two ways a child can earn or save money safely. (2 marks)

44. Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name. (3 marks)

45. Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave. (3 marks)

46. State three things that nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

47. Explain the message of the last verse of Surah Al-Kafirun. (3 marks)

48. State four duties of children to their parents. (4 marks)

49. Describe three good manners of eating apart from saying Bismillah. (3 marks)

50. Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care. (3 marks)

51. Why are Al-Falaq and An-Naas called the two surahs of seeking refuge? (3 marks)

52. Choose any two prophets and explain one virtue from the life of each. (5 marks)

53. Write the meaning of the first two verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (2 marks)

54. How should a Muslim treat dogs even though their saliva is heavy najasa? (3 marks)

55. Explain what the Prophet taught about cutting and selling firewood. (3 marks)

56. Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq? (3 marks)

57. State four features of the Islamic code of dressing. (4 marks)

58. Explain how not brushing teeth can harm them. (4 marks)

59. Explain what integrity means when using a phone. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Allah is One and has no equal
   The surah declares the oneness of Allah.

2. A — Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   Tajweed means reciting the Qur'an with correct rules of pronunciation.

3. C — 6
   An-Naas has six verses.

4. C — Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   These are Sunnah manners.

5. C — Talking with a full mouth
   Chewing with the mouth open and talking is impolite.

6. B — Fresh breath
   Clean teeth give fresh breath.

7. B — Say "alayhis-salam"
   We say peace be upon him.

8. D — Light
   The Prophet said angels were created from light.

9. C — Israfil
   Israfil blows the Trumpet by Allah's command.

10. D — Yaqub
   Yusuf was the son of Yaqub.

11. B — Giving freely without expecting anything back
   Generous people give willingly.

12. A — Urine of a baby boy who feeds only on milk
   Light najasa is cleaned by sprinkling.

13. B — It prevents diseases like diarrhoea
   Cleanliness prevents germs.

14. C — It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   Prayer is not accepted without it.

15. A — Leaving the tap running
   Islam teaches us not to waste water.

16. B — Up to and including the elbows
   Qur'an 5:6 says to the elbows.

17. C — Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   Tartib means this order.

18. B — The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   It is recited in sitting.

19. D — Pray as you have seen me praying
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari.

20. D — Allah is the Greatest
   Takbir means Allah is the Greatest.

21. A — A goat
   Animals are living creatures of Allah.

22. C — Ask parents before using devices
   Permission keeps children safe.

23. B — Prayer, homework and helping at home
   Priorities first.

24. C — Avoiding begging without justification
   Self-awareness.

25. B — It is better than asking people
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

26. A — Do not drive him away
   We should be kind.

27. C — Quietly and kindly
   Protect dignity.

28. C — As-salamu alaykum
   Greet with salaam.

29. C — Bring water, help and make dua
   Care for them.

30. B — Being kind to parents
   Kindness to parents is very important.

31. A — When they command something Allah forbids
   Obedience is in what is good.

32. D — As-salamu alaykum
   A Muslim greeting.

33. D — Still visit them kindly
   Keep ties even if they do not.

34. A — Jibril
   Jibril brings revelation.

35. B — Hira
   The cave of Hira.

36. D — About forty
   He was about forty.

37. D — Freed believers and supported Islam
   He bought and freed people.

38. B — Threw stones at him
   His feet were hurt.

39. A — Zayd ibn Haritha
   Zayd was his companion.

40. A — The Year of Sorrow
   The Prophet lost two supporters.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: He placed the stone on a cloak and asked a leader from each tribe to hold an edge and lift it together, then he set it in place.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cloak, 1 mark for leaders lifting together, 1 mark for setting it in place.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Chores for a small reward with permission, and saving in a box or school scheme.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: "For you is your religion and for me is mine." A Muslim stays firm in his faith and respects the right of others to hold their beliefs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for firmness, 1 mark for respect.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Obey in good, respect, thank and make dua, help at home, care for them when old, be honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands before, eat with the right hand, eat from in front, do not criticise food, do not waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge". In them we ask Allah to protect us from harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the opening words, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for protection.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ayyub showed patience in illness; Ibrahim showed generosity to guests.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each prophet, 1 mark for each virtue, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read in the name of your Lord who created; He created man from a clinging clot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kindly, without cruelty, giving them food and water, and only being careful to avoid their saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for not cruel, 1 mark for careful with saliva.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honest work, even hard work like cutting and selling firewood, is better than asking people who may give or refuse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest work, 1 mark for firewood, 1 mark for better than begging.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food and sugar stay on the teeth, germs turn them into acid, and acid makes cavities which cause toothache and bad breath.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four steps or harms.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Doing the right thing even when nobody sees, because Allah sees and angels record. For example not cheating or copying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for Allah sees, 1 mark for example.
